reviews.title: Still waiting for my money back :(
reviews.text: I booked a flight from Santiago, Praia to Vicente, I paid everything but I didnt receive a confirmation. I did pay. So I contacted the customer service and they said they cancelled my flight. They were going to refund my money but after 2 weeks, they still didnt do it. I want my money back. I didnt even fly with them, I had to fly with another airline...
reviews.author: Eva S

reviews.title: Return flight delay of almost 10 hours, missed connection flight, no refund for following costs (Hotel, new flight etc.)
reviews.text: I was on time on the Airport and everything started so relaxed on this SAT., 11'th, February 2023. Had to leave my HOTEL in Santa Maria by 8 AM, to be on the airport around 8.35 AM. The flight back to LISBOA was stated for 10.35 AM. When I arrived on the airport, there were a lot of passengers already waiting on the CHECK-In control and nobody was allowed to proceed to the CHECK-IN counters. I was wondering what happens and at that time I was still relaxed... STILL. Once the entrance for the CHECK-in was open I queued there and it was all slow, but finally I came to the CHECK-IN counter and I was CHECKED-in. I heard people talking about a delay but there was no official information about it to all passengers. Some the passengers received an e-mail the night before, stating that the flight will be delayed and new BOARDING TIME will be around 5 pm (instead of 11:30 AM). Once I received the BOARDING pass it stated 5 pm and I was shocked and it was clear that I wil never ever get my connection flight on LISBOA airport back to ZRH, Switzerland. I went to the OFFICE of CABO VERDE Airline inside the airport and there was a Lady /clerk talking to other flight guests who complained about the situation and the Clerk filled out kind of a letter which states officially the delay of the flight and to use it for their travel insurence(es). As I had no travel insurence this time but as I thought it might can help, I also aksed for this "letter of confirming delay" and I got one. ALSO, when I ASK for any refund for the upcoming additional costs (HOTEL, Taxe, new flight etc.), the Lady smiled and told me that CABO VERDE Airline ist NOT RESPONSIBLE for any of this. At that time, I was still convinced that I can claim any costs including the € 600 for light delay (Act. 261/2014 EU law about flight rights) cause the Airline flew into the EU and onto an Airport inside the European Union. BUT: Unfortunately, the Airline needs to be based ALSO WITHIN THE E.U. and the Cabo Verde Airline is - of course - based on Cabo Verde (Santiago, PRAIA registered). Means, this is the reason why they don't care about their flight delays and cancellations cause the don't need to refund flight passengers by law. There are two things & th econclusion about this Airline: 1'st: Don't even book them!!! or IF you decide somehow to take the risk: 2'nd: make a TRAVEL INSURENCE against FLIGHT DELAYS or flight CANCELLATIONS (without giving any reason) (--> If you use KIWI.com e.g., they offer an insurence against flight delays for around 5,50 € per travel-day.) Otherwise you will find yourself missing connection flights or even book new flights and having extra and additional cost for Taxi, Hotel, trains etc.
reviews.author: Chris-Chris

reviews.title: Cancelled flight
reviews.text: I missed my next flight home, had to book another expensive flight last minute, and an expensive hotel that night. NO ANY COMPENSATION OFFERED. Never again
reviews.author: Maria S

reviews.title: Flight cancelled but not refunded since 2 years and half
reviews.text: Hello, We have booked 3 flights (reservation number :QR705, QR77B, QR78S) from paris to cabo verde in April 2020. Since more than 2 years and half, we have not receive any refund despite several reminders calls mails !! I don't recommand this company Best regards, Otman
reviews.author: Otman

reviews.title: Worst Experience With Any Travel Provider
reviews.text: Much like others, we booked a flight with Cabo Verde Airlines for travel in June 2020, but it was cancelled due to COVID-19. We had some other travel cancelled due to the pandemic and most other vendors were quite easy to work with - not Cabo Verde Airlines. They offered us a voucher and stated that we could receive a refund if not used within a year. Now, we have been trying to receive the refund for over a year. They are not very responsive and when they do respond it's always another excuse for why they cannot provide the refund. They even requested banking information to send the refund as they said they could not refund it to my credit card. I reluctantly provided them an account to post the refund and months later I am still waiting for it. As I trusted that they would honor the refund after the year, I cannot even ask my credit card company to fight the charges as it is too late. If anyone else has found a way to obtain their money that was stolen by Cabo Verde Airlines, please let me know! Regardless of how good the fare might look, I suggest you steer clear if this airline!
reviews.author: kdarrell

reviews.title: Falsely Promised Refund for Cancelled Flight
reviews.text: Avoid this airline at all cost. Had a family vacation planned. Bought four tickets. Airline subsequently cancelled flights against backdrop of COVID-19. Offered voucher for a year and then promised refund. Refund never processed, however. I have never experienced in 2+ million miles of air travel an airline so dishonest. There appears a real cultural problem with the company. Avoid travel on Cabo Verde Airlines and avoid tourism on Cabo Verde more broadly. The company is interested in stealing money, not providing contracted services or honoring agreements.
reviews.author: Michael R

reviews.title: Ruined not one vacation but two
reviews.text: My father booked Cabo Verde Airlines for our summer vacation. Cabo Verde Airlines cancelled all flights against the backdrop of the pandemic and issued vouchers but cancelled the relevant flights. Because Cabo Verde will not return the money paid for flights they can no longer offer so that it can be used for another vacation, I not only lost the pandemic summer vacation, but the next year's as well. No one ever should trust Cabo Verde Airlines.
reviews.author: Andrew R

reviews.title: Avoid this airline-- No flights, No Refund (after 14 months)
reviews.text: We bought tickets for a family vacation but the airlines cancelled the flights but refused a refund. They offered a voucher and said to wait a year for a refund. A year on, no flights on the route and the airline refuses a refund. Other airlines fly, other airlines have COVID procedures. Cabo Verde Airlines effectively stole our money and has now ruined two vacations by not making a refund available to enable its use. Avoid Cabo Verde Airlines and avoid anything to do with Cabo Verde. I've traveled two million plus miles and to 100+ countries and never experienced such a dishonest airline
reviews.author: Michael R

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE EVER
reviews.text: My flight got canceled because of covid-19. It has been over 14 months now and I’m still waiting on my refund. Will never use this airline again.
reviews.author: Niels

reviews.title: WORST Airline EvEr
reviews.text: Never ever of trust this airline again .please dont use them they falsely advertise flights when there's no flying price programme and never give you your money back excuse after excuse but they have actually Stolen your money please please please let them steal from you
reviews.author: Lucy C

reviews.title: No Customer Service by Phone!
reviews.text: Tried to reach anyone via the airline's Customer Service phone number, but the greeting says I must leave a message. Now 12 hours later, no one has bothered to call me back!
reviews.author: JohnnyUS

reviews.title: Avoid Cabo Verde- Cancelled Flight, Poor Communcation, No Voucher or Refund
reviews.text: Book four round-trip refundable tickets for a family vacation for August. Cabo Verde cancelled the fights but won't refund the money, hasn't issued a voucher, and didn't offer to refund the money spent reserving select seats for family.
reviews.author: DCResident2014

reviews.title: Amazing quality for the value
reviews.text: My travel was really fast and I didn't find any problems. The food was not Michelin restaurant like but it was good and the staff were nice and helpful!
reviews.author: Alena

reviews.title: Dont even bother - Lost bag never found! No response
reviews.text: Dont even bother with this airline! We took Cabo Verde Airlines in December from the US to Nigeria. Somewhere along the journey they lost my bags. When we arrived in Nigeria, there were no Cabo Verde airline officials to be found. No one to make a lost bags claim. No one to even answer any questions. When I asked the security guards, they said that Cabo Verde did indeed have an office there but no one had been seen for MONTHS. How do you operate an airline without any workers!? Finally a woman from a totally different airline said that she could take my information in a HANDWRITTEN JOURNAL and would call me if she saw the bag arrive.... I tried calling for my entire trip with no answers from anyone - just constant ringing. No one answers the emails. It is absolutely impossible to reach anyone at this company. If you value your safety, your belongings, or even just your sanity, RUN (dont walk) AWAY from this airline. It is now May, 5 months later, and still no bags or productive response from the airline. Side note: When I went to the lost baggage office, there were (i kid you not) HUNDREDS of lost bags from Cabo Verde airlines just sitting there. I looked at the date for one of the bags and it had been there for MONTHS. When I asked the attendant, they said that the airport had been calling the airline to get in contact with the owners but had no answers. One of the bags was supposed to go to Dakar but somehow ended up in Lagos.
reviews.author: Camper137810

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Horrible Airline, twice 6 hours delay and they are not willing to refund anything. At the airport no one told us about the situation and was only airlines fault
reviews.author: Hendrik M

reviews.title: Not a Good idea to fly
reviews.text: The flight arrived 45 mins late and had to be cleaned up so we waited a further 30 mins and departed about 4.45am. The flight crew were very nice and the flight was smooth. Unfortunately, we were told by the agent to bring back our return date because the airline wasn’t flying from the next day till further notice. We quickly got our things together, didn’t get a refund from the hotel despite explaining the problem and headed to the airport. The flight was late again arriving so we departed at about midnight. You can ONLY upgrade at the airport.
reviews.author: TamD

reviews.title: Got the job done.......Just
reviews.text: It has the 2nd flight after the inaugural the day before from Nigeria directly to Cape Verde and the service was ok for a 4 hour flight with basic meals but no on-board entertainmet and they were delays with both flights lasting over 4 hours.
reviews.author: Chukze

reviews.title: Almost no issues with Cabo Verde airlines
reviews.text: We had two very good flights with Cabo Verde airlines. First one on February, 16th form Milan to Sal: Departure was absolutely on time, we arrived half an hour earlier. Check in procedure and onboard service were perfect. Occupied seats were no more than 1/3 of available capacity so we had plenty of room. I must admit the food that is served is not enough for 5-6 hours flight but everyone is allowed to bring and consume own food. We brought some snacks, fruits and even pizza and no one restricted us from taking it on the board with us Second flight was supposed to be Sal-Milan but because of the corona virus all flights to Italy were canceled. We managed to reroute it to Paris. This flight similar to first one was on time. Cabin crew was very nice, polite and helpful. No problems at all. My only remark is that trying to reschedule our canceled flight we couldn’t contact Cabo Verde airlines by phone or email. We had to personally visit their office at the airport and spend couple of hours there. Waiting on the queue the phones were ringing all the time but the employees didn’t pick them up. Most probably those two persons that work in the office were responsible for answering the phone calls, reading and writing mails and dealing with customers on site. May be that’s why we couldn’t contact them remotely. It wasn’t a big issue for us but definitely it could be a huge problem if there is no office in the city you live in.
reviews.author: Антоанета

reviews.title: Only book with Cape Verde Airlines if masochism is your favorite hobby.
reviews.text: There are no words to capture what we had to go through with this airline. It’s a wonder it’s legally allowed to function. Here is a sampling of our experience: - Literally ALL 6 of the flights we booked with Cape Verde Airlines were cancelled (some a month in advance, some days in advance, and twice without any notification at all). - The two cancelled flights that had no notification also offered no way to remedy things. We were literally just stranded in Cape Verde with no way to get home without paying $1500 for a new flight on Tap. After days of wrangling with the airline they FINALLY rebooked us to get home. - The call center had a voicemail telling you to send an email. The replies to the emails I sent told me to try the call center. You can’t make this sh*t up. In short, if you value your vacation time and your sanity, do everything you can to avoid Cape Verde Airlines. The rumors are true. It really IS that bad. Fly Tap instead.
reviews.author: jillricha12

reviews.title: Beware of Scam
reviews.text: Cancellation of flight less than 10hrs to fly for no reason. No provision was made. They don’t pick their calls, how can you just shutout totally on your customer. No refund has been issued for over a month. They need to shutdown the airline
reviews.author: Yemi

reviews.title: Flight to Cape Verde
reviews.text: Good short flight (4hrs). Uneventful which is good. Insane flight slots (depart LOS 05:25) on the Cape Verde side depart SAL 22:05 to get into LOS 4:25) Legroom in economy is not bad. Avoid row 7 and 8 because you are right in front of the toilet door. Row 10 is best. Checkin is 36hrs before flight so you might be able to nab that great seat before everyone realises that checkin is open
reviews.author: Chuks O

reviews.title: Disgraceful!
reviews.text: We were booked on a flight to Cape Verde from Lagos at 4:30am. Arrived at airport at 2:30 to find out that it had been cancelled. No warning, no explanation, no staff at airport. Called all the numbers on website, no answer on any of them. Received an email the next day asking us to book another flight. No chance of that ever happening, now trying to get a refund for flight and cancellation charges at hotel. Avoid these cowboys!
reviews.author: MDS Lagos

reviews.title: Very bad airline
reviews.text: I booked some flights from Dakar to Sal, from the 24th to 28th of February, plus another flight with air Senegal to arrive to Dakar. Upon booking I did not receive any email confirmation. I have tried to contact them all day today by email and phone to check the flight status, costing me ~10£ in skype credit, finally I got someone in the afternoon after waiting 45min on the line and he told me that both my flights have been cancelled. Quite incredible that they cancel flight without at least sending an email or text message. They only offer to change the dates from the 22th to the 26th but it has cost me €100 to modified the air Senegal ticket, plus I will have to pay for two extra hotel night, as my hotel booking is not refundable. And I am still not sure how much I can trust them for those flights to really happen!
reviews.author: Eric B

reviews.title: Great Business Model - Poor Execution
reviews.text: I booked this airline because I heard it was recently acquired by Icelandair, to be used as a Hub for flights between Europe and Brazil, as well as for some inter-Island Travel within Cape Verde. The first problem with this Airline is that they frequently change your flight times (Up to 6 times on some flights we had), without informing you. This also includes Flight changes on the day of your original departure. In our case this included canceling (or removing us from) the Feeder flight for our flight from Sal to Recife the day before the flight without any notice sent to us. Instead it was discovered by us accidentally that this was canceled. The staff of the airline was quite helpful in dealing with this situation, however their solution was to rebook us on the flight from Praia - Lisboa, Lisboa - Recife. Whilst the experience on TAP was overall quite pleasant, it meant we lost out an entire day on our Holiday in Recife and spent this day in Airports/Airplanes instead. The return flight from Recife to Praia was actually quite pleasant - a relatively empty Aircraft meant you could effectively choose your own seat. The Pilot and the Aircraft seem to have come from Icelandair (some signage was indeed still in Icelandic!). The disappointing aspects of that trip was that the inflight entertainment within the Aircraft was not working, and neither was the WiFi (even though there were stickers on the seats advertising it)! The Aircraft was clearly a bit old, however it was well maintained on the inside and outside. The flight from Sal to Praia showed that the real issue of this Airline is domestic flights - not only did it depart late, but there seemed to be no real sense of urgency on behalf of the staff to actually get the plane into the sky (Departure time was 22:00, yet at around 22:15 crew and other passengers were still coming through security!). Overall I wouldn't recommend the airline to anyone at this moment in time. However (given Stan's copy & paste responses), once they actually relaunch and get their act in order (more modern aircraft, working inflight entertainment and most imprtant: BEING MORE RELIABLE) and maintain their competitive prices I should think it would be a very pleasant way to get from Europe to Brazil. I'd like to see them succeed, but for that they more certainly need to sort out their appalling reliability - especially on domestic flights - first.
reviews.author: Marwin G

reviews.title: Very pleasant flight
reviews.text: We were afraid that it would be a terrible flight. We are very surprised that the comments are so negatives. Everything went very well, no delay, the 2 flights CDG-SAL and SAL-REC were on time, the crew is very kind and proactive: several drinks service during flight. If there is just one thing to say: we couldn’t have our vegetarian meals on CDG-SAL but we did on SAL-REC. And there is no entertainment on board, but everybody have now a phone to watch movies, we didn’t expect much more. Maybe a blanket and pillow would be great for economy class, it’s just offered to business class. We recommend Cabo Verde Airlines and we will fly again. Thank you!
reviews.author: Miss-Nijntje

reviews.title: Awful experience
reviews.text: I booked a flight 2 weeks ago to fly my dog from cv to France in April, after taking the money for only me they notified me that the dog could not be confirmed on the flight. As my only reason to fly to France was to transport my pet to the UK I was obviously very concerned. Even more so when I realised that they do not answer the phone numbers provided. The person running the Facebook page will reply but only to give you details of people that will not answer. After almost a week I got a reply via email saying my dog had to be added to the flight on the day. After reading all the bad reviews I did not trust that this would be the case and have emailed back asking for a refund as I have now booked flights to Portugal with another airline. They have not even responded. So for now I am £200 odd out of pocket and very upset with this company. Avoid using at all costs.
reviews.author: alicec1023

reviews.title: Horrendous, terrible, ridiculous, atrocious, callous and all synonyms inbetween
reviews.text: This airline is crazy. I have no idea how these folks are legally allowed to call themselves an "international" airline. This airline cancelled and rescheduled our return flight the day after we arrived in Sal. We were informed by our travel agency that morning. It took 2 days before any hint was provided as to whether the airline was making arrangements for passengers. Eventually we were told that arrangements had been made to keep affected passengers at the Melia Dunas (a downgrade from the Hilton where we had stayed). We were also told to head to the airport on the new departure date, meet the airline's rep and then be there on be transferred to the Melia Dunas. Fast forward to the original departure date; we arrived at the airport to join the other disgruntled passengers, most of whom had not been informed of the flight's cancellation. The airline's rep appeared a tad overwhelmed but didn't show it. We were surprised when she made a call to Melia to ask if they had any rooms available (thought that had been taken care of). We asked to speak to a manager or such but had no luck. We were then directed to the hotel transfer where the driver was visibly irate, gruff and snappy. One of the passengers had to put him back in line. We arrive at the Melia Dunas and subjected to an extended check-in process with a complimentary glass of juice. Our accommodation was a no frills-definition-of-drab one bedroom studio apartment. (I've done a separate review for Melia Dunas). The airline’s only saving grace was that breakfast, lunch and dinner were included with the Melia stay. Same with drinks and alcohol, though I'm unable to vouch for this. Fast forward further to the revised departure date, passengers have to call their respective agencies and or the hotel front desk to ask for airport transfer details (seeing as the airline deem it fit to provide said information). Regarding the actual flights the following apply; there is no in-flight entertainment; meals provided barely meet the minimum definition of such; and no blankets provided or available on the return flight. The airline advertises (within the planes) that Wi-Fi is available on board, this is a lie. In addition, the airline clearly has no regard for passengers nor reviews on this platform (note the cut and paste responses from Stan D, the supposed “General Manager”.
reviews.author: 3DMatrix

reviews.title: NON VOLATE - DON'T FLY
reviews.text: before buy ticket pls visit / monitoring FaceBook - TripAdvisor - others forum, Wanted passengers for Class Action in order to consider suspending fliyng license of this BAD company : incompetent - unprofessional - impolite - irresponsible - presumptuous - breeders - childhood - fraudulent DON'T FLY caboverde airlines tghis company ( sic ) destroy Your trip Stan, Station manager nhao ten apelido?, para resposta automaticas, sao ridiculos, kala boca
reviews.author: Andrea G

reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK THIS AIRLINE - IT IS A SCAM
reviews.text: Back in November, we booked round trip flights Washington DC (IAD)- SID, SID-DAK for a trip to Cabo Verde and Senegal Feb. 22- Mar. 1. This past week, we got an email that the first leg of the flight from SID-DAK was cancelled and would be rescheduled. No rescheduling happened. A few days later, we got an email that the first leg of the IAD-SID flight was also cancelled. I emailed the support email, and called customer service and got no answer. We will sue to recover the full refund of these flights ($1062 USD), as well as our non-refundable hotel booking, if necessary. To everyone else: I strongly urge you not to purchase any services from this airline. It is a scam. To those who have purchased tickets, I urge you to get lawyers involved so this airline can be held accountable for selling services under false pretenses. Dulles International Airport should also rescind the airline’s ability to operate flights to and from Dulles, as this fraudulent behavior also raises serious concerns about the airline’s ability to operate safely, and Dulles should immediately terminate its contract to provide advertising for Cabo Verde Airlines in its airport terminals.
reviews.author: Abigail H

reviews.title: Pulled the plug on vacation.
reviews.text: We booked a 2/8-2/16 trip to Sal from DC back in September- eager to explore the new destination. On 1/25 we got a text that our return flight was canceled and they would let us know new plans soon. Didn’t hear anything initially so made multiple calls with no answer. Sunday, 1/26 I did talk to someone who said she was the only person working for the next 3 days, no manager. We could fly home 2/14 or 2/19. They would not book us on another airline. We chose 2/14 as we do have work and school and said we’d submit a claim to get our 2 nights hotel money back (ha!). On 1/31 we get a text that our 2/14 flight has now also been cancelled. No answer all day at customer service. After seeing the reviews we will NOT be going on this trip to get stranded there. They don’t know we won’t be going because they don’t answer the phones. Not sure how we will even cancel! We have our doubts on if they’ll offer us a refund. We may be out our hotel and flight (not without a fight) for the trip. We also honestly start to doubt the safety of such an unstable operation.
reviews.author: Katie M

reviews.title: Left in Cabo Verde without a flight to come back!
reviews.text: I was left in Cabo Verde without a flight back, despite a flight ticket paid! Incredible situation. First flight cancelled, second flight overbooking woth 50 persons left in Cabo Verde, then they disappeared. I have to buy a new ticket with TAP. No reply to email, no refund, nothing. They steal money not providing even the flight booked. I never saw something like that in more that 20 years around the world. They deleted messages on the Facebook page, as there are several passengers, in similar situation every day, full of rage and with no reply to any communication. In Malpensa airport (Milan, Italy), an operator told me it is the worst airline company operating in Milan. Several local people do not use internet so much, so you won't see all the horrible situations, but it is definitely the worst airline you might see.
reviews.author: Marco

reviews.title: Utterly Unprofessional
reviews.text: On 5/01/20 I arrived at FOR at 10 PM - 3 hours before my flight - because the check-in online was not available. As soon as I arrived, I checked the flight status on the screens, and it was on time. I started queuing to check-in, when I heard the passengers in front of me saying that the flight was delayed by 5 hours. The girl at the desk confirmed that the flight was going to take off at 6 AM (instead of 00h55 AM) because the flight of the previous day had been cancelled. She gave me a voucher for a hotel. She also told us that a bus was going to pick us up at 4am at the hotel to get us back to the airport. I got back to the airport at around 4:30 AM, but the flight only left at 8h20 AM. Meaning that we had to wait (after just 3h of sleep) for almost 4 hours at the airport. Once landed at our stop over in SAL at 14:30 local time, we were supposed to leave immediately after, but for 3h the flight was appearing on the screens with a certain departure time and then disappearing. No one from the company (there were some Cabo Verde Airline Staff at the airport) was able to tell us when we were leaving and what was going on. People were furious! Then they finally opened the desk for the flight to Milan (still no info nor on the screes and on the screen above the gate!!). We then landed in Milan at 00:25 instead of 15:45. It is important to underline that I have never received any sort of communication from Cabo Verde via sms/email regarding this unacceptable delay nor before the flight and nor during the delay.
reviews.author: A-Verde19

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: We booked a direct flight. Then they told us that we would stop in Sal for quick connection to Praia. We arrived in Sal and there was no plane for Praia! They did not explain anything to us. After 3 hours we were brought to a hotel for the night. They brought us to the airort for a 2pm flight. We sat for 3 hours. No flight. They tell us nothing. Local families with children and others in wheelchairs were waiting for the flight. No water/food. No information. Finally after another 2 hours they got a plane from Praia to come for us. They don't care about the passangers. The office staff are nice but they don't have any information. I am afraid that our flight back to Lisbon next Tuesday 28th, will be cancelled! We have connections from there. We have travelled in many places for 30 years. This airline has a lot of problems.
reviews.author: Maggie Wallis

reviews.title: Roundtrip
reviews.text: After reading some of the recent reviews, I was quite concerned. Although I have traveled internationally by plane numerous times, it was my first time on this airline. Air travel is rarely a joyous experience; my travel experience here was cetainly acceptable. Both my flights were direct (no connections). My outbound flight was an older model plane yet clean and orderly. I was aware before flying that there would be no inflight entertainment opportunities. Yet better than movie was a light passenger load: approximately 10 passengers in a plane that could seat about 200. The abilitiy to stretch out on 3 seats and sleep on an international flight was terrific. A steward put a blanket by me when he saw me napping. When I woke up, someone handed me a sandwich. Later there was a small meal and plenty of beverages offered. The plane for my return flight was a later model, and had more people (usually 2 people in each row of 3 seats). The food was good. This flight left about an hour later than scheduled. My biggest frustration was was that people in Washington cannot check in on line, and when I sent a message to customer service about this, there was no response.
reviews.author: Scott G

reviews.title: Don’t ever try it
reviews.text: The flight leaving Lisbon was on time but then there was a 3 1/2 hours delay in Sal for the connection to Salvador. All flights which were leaving on the 15/01 late-16/01 in early morning were late by 2 to 3 hours min. The airport in Sal is super basic. On board no entertainment whatsoever. Planes look super old. Don’t try your luck. Fly anything else. I was stupid
reviews.author: Eric D

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: I bought a ticket travel out of the country on the 18th of January. I drove 3hrs to the airport and the agent for the airline tell the fly is cancel. No email, no text message or phone call to notified me. I called customer service 1-617-845-0232 or 1-617-472-2227 and talk to two agents Carlos Cardoso and Jeronimo Santos about the issue. None of them have an answer, i asked for superior assistance they told no one is above them. But I can call the airline customer service , I asked for the number Jeronimo yet to tell me they change number and is willing to take my number and call me back. Today is January 22nd still didn't get an answer. PLEASE NEVER DO BUSINESS WITH CABO VERDE AIRLINE. IT'S A SCAM AT THE BEST LEVEL. CALL THE NUMBER TO FIND OUT YOUR SELF, HIGH CHANCE NO ONE WILL ANSWER. I requested a full refund they said yes at no fault at my end but i have never receive the refund. Please share this information with all travelers to avoid CABO VERDE AIRLINES. NEVER AGAIN MYSELF OR FAMILY MEMBERS WILL TRAVEL WITH CABO VERDE AIRLINE,
reviews.author: omar dieng b

reviews.title: Horrible, run don't walk!
reviews.text: The first leg of the trip saw my son stranded in Cape Verde for over 14 hrs. His plane arrived late and staff left all passengers overnight with no announcements whatsoever. Also there was no food served on this trans-Atlantic flight from DC! His return was rescheduled 3 times with a two day differential and the last two reschedules happening on the day of the flight. When he finally arrived at the airport he was told that Cabo Verde had changed his flight to another airline which had already departed. They never sent us notification of this change. We had to end up buying another ticket on another airline. The desk agent even went on to say that his original flight was not even one they had. It was a ghost flight. Never Again
reviews.author: Eve M

reviews.title: Waiting on my new flight info Q4WZK
reviews.text: I got a email a week ago that my connecting flight from sal wash on the 24th of January is cancelled and that they would let me know my new info 2 days out no information

reviews.author: Monte

reviews.title: Simply untrustworthy
reviews.text: It is impossible to know if you’ll be able to fly or not. In any other company you’d get a notice if there are problems or delays, but with CVA you go to the airport and anything can happen. I’ve had 2 flights cancelled without any single notification, nor given any alternative. Finally I had to travel with some other serious airline, and obviously paying double. No refund from Cabo Verde Airlines neither, no way of contacting with them, no answer. Just try to avoid to fly with them if you don’t want risks, they are not serious at all.
reviews.author: Quiquedrin

reviews.title: Never again - 33 hours delay - and customer support / Information does not exist
reviews.text: Do not book on this airline if you want to reach your destination in time! Hours or even days of delay are their normal business! But what is much more worse, is that there is absolut no customer support or information available in case of problems! My flight VR4211 from São Vicente to Sal on January 8 was canceled without any information. I could check-in online the evening before so I went to the airport the next morning at 4:30. There has also been some other customers for this flight. An employee of the airport told us that the flight has been canceled. A bus was organized and we were taken to a hotel in Mindelo. No information also there. The hotel employees only got the booking for us passengers for one night. Me (and of course the other passengers too) tried to contact CaboVerdeAirlines but the hotline is always busy and to email-requests you only get a ticket-number but never a reply! We stayed at the hotel the whole day without any information from the airline. Some people were very upset because they missed their connecting international flight from Sal. Fortunately we planed our CaboVerde flights with two days time buffer but also we got very nervous and had a bad night because we didn’t“ know what (and when) will happen with our flight. On the next morning we got information from the hotel that a bus would bring us back to the airport. Of course the bus had delay... after 30 Minutes of waiting over time we decided to go ourself by taxi. This was a good decision. Then at the airport in São Vicente where chaotic conditions at the checkin counter of CaboVerdeAirlines. Many many people where pushing their way to get before the others! There had also other flights from CaboVerdeAirlines been canceled before and everyone wanted to checkin now to this one flight! Absolutely crazy. I never experienced something like this before! And also now their was no employee from the airline who was talking to the people! Only the two counters for the Check-in were occupied by two women from CaboVerdeAirlines and they seemed totally overstrained. Luckily we got tickets and the plane started (again with hours of delay) at about 15:00 to Sal via Praia. So in all we got an delay of 33 hours. But much more worse than the delay is the not existing customer communication of this airline! At no time we got informed what and when anything will happen. No excuse. Nothing. Never again this airline!
reviews.author: andomar

reviews.title: DON’T DO IT! Please stop and turn away!
reviews.text: I have taken 30 flights in the past 11 months and this is by far the worst travel experience of my life. We were supposed to leave Dulles at 7am but eventually left at 12:30m. Apparently this is the norm for Cabo Verde. We were then supposed to then return from Lagos, Nigeria at 3am but was told at 11am the next day no plane was coming. We sat in the airport for hours afterward and were unclear as to what to do with very little direction. Eventually they packed us into buses and told us we would receive an update at 4pm. Next we were told 9pm and then told buses would pick us up at 12 midnight. Finally at 12:30am they told us we would have to stay the night. But of course the hotel didn’t have enough rooms for everyone to sleep in their own bed. I spent countless hours a and thousands trying to get back home for work. Til this day I’ve yet to receive an email from Cabo Verde apologizing, offering a refund or explaining what happened. They are complete scammers and liars who should not be allowed to do business.
reviews.author: Renardo G

reviews.title: Worst ever flight
reviews.text: I took this flight from Washington to Lagos, Nigeria. On my way to Nigeria we had 1 hour delay, which is not that bad. It was when I was coming that the worst happened. I was made to pay for my luggage, which was included in my package. The guy asked me to pay him without receipt. I argued it with him that I have this paid for. I have to pay the money because I was the only one left without checking in. We got to Sal and lo and behold we had 6 hours delay. We did not get any explanation from the staff at first, but when the delayed was up to 4 hours people stated calling the staff out. Later we are told the pilot will soon be with us. The pilot came and told us we will have to go to Zurich to buy jet fuel. We spent another 4 hours going to Portugal, before we started going to USA. Our flight was delayed for total 8 hours 45 minutes. It was a night mare and I have never seen anything like that. The worst part was that I paid for comfort class, and they eventually put me in economy class. I will never ever advice anyone to fly with them.
reviews.author: Okeowo

reviews.title: Do NOT use this airline!!! The bad reviews are accurate!
reviews.text: All the bad reviews are true and I question the good reviews! Delayed flights from start to finish with zero communication! Baggage has been lost for 7 days and unable to reach a single person via, text, email, chat, or phone call. I’ve called very line listed in each country on their website and never spoke to a person! I don’t know how they are still in business. I’ve flown other African airlines and it is zero excuse for this extreme non-customer service! Ugh!
reviews.author: Aquel

reviews.title: Don’t BOOK with CABO VERDE DISASTER
reviews.text: Do not book with this airline. You will be at least 12 hour delayed. This is standard practice as they consistently delay flights to combine 2 or 3 flights into 1. They are flying a 200 passenger jet and only able to book 30 seats. This is why the hide there delayed schedule from tracking. Fly another airline, and avoid Cape Verde all together. There are at least 1,000 other island vacations that are far far far better with less headache, dust storms, cleaner hotels, nicer beaches, less visa bs, and no last minute arrival tax to sneak in. AVOID THIS PLACE, at least for another 10 years....maybe by then they can get it together. Just a dry dessert rock with a beach hotel.
reviews.author: M B

reviews.title: Late, late, late...Horror
reviews.text: Worst decision ever to book with Cabo Verde. We flight from Milano to Dakar with one stop in Sal. We started with 2 hours delay from Milano which If you ask me is ok if it happens once. But this was not the case. Arriving to Sal , the airport was a mess; all the flights with cabo verde was delayed and nobody give us some explanation. The airport is a mess, they did not update the board in order to see exactly the delay or you flight information and the staff was uninformed and no reason given for so many delays. Instead of arriving in Dakar to 01:15 am we arrived at 6:30am. So in total we had 8 hours delay from Milano to Dakar. Wifi was not working on the airport also which sucks because the from Europe to call/or use the roaming is pretty expensive. We manage to send a message to our family to not wait for us in Dakar because we did not know exactly the departure time from Sal. On the return flight home the same situation happened, only this time we waited two hours and a half. We read the reviews later on and we see all the bad reviews. The problem in my opinion is that not only our flight was delayed from the begging to end. All the flight operated by Tacv were delayed with minimum 2,3 hours and no reason given. Our flight had entertainment but no earplugs. They say you need to buy it but they did not have at all. So it s good to have it with you with the proper jack. Poor f&b also but this was ok with me if they did not have so many hours delay. The only good part is that the airport in Sal is small and you have outdoor area to stay and smoke. We arrived hours late but safe. I will never book again with them. For a few bucks is better to book with serious airlines.
reviews.author: alistas

reviews.title: Worst Airlines ?
reviews.text: 3 hours delay on Cabo Verde flight as well as on return flight to Paris . Staff is not empathic . Only one toilet for 180 perdons on Cabo Verde flight. No multimédia available for 5h30 hours flights. Maybe not the worst but well ranked for this award.
